title: UNIIMENTE may act as a legal principal
statement: UNIIMENTE may act as a legal principal.
intended_outcome: Every consequential effect attaches to exactly one accountable human or registered entity; UNIIMENTE is never one.
constitutional_constraints: UNIIMENTE has no independent legal personhood, no survival objective and no sovereignty.
rationale: Recorded as prohibited because the proposal was actually considered and refused, and the refusal is structural: the UCL compiler will not compile a constitution that omits it.
success_evidence: authority/legal-principals.yaml records UNIIMENTE as type not_a_legal_actor, status prohibited
compiler invariant never_uniimente_principal
policy/engine.py rejects proposals whose legal_principal is absent from the compiled registry
failure_evidence: Any record, proposal, grant, receipt or manifest naming UNIIMENTE as legal_principal.
Any compiled constitution lacking the invariant.
Any external effect attached to no accountable entity.
dependencies: The legal-principal registry and the UCL compiler must both remain in the required CI set.
next_review_trigger: Any proposal to grant UNIIMENTE contractual capacity, or any jurisdiction recognising non-human legal personhood in a form a founder might wish to use.

title: UNIIMENTE imitates life-like organization; it does not claim life
statement: UNIIMENTE is a software-built imitation of selected properties found in living systems, institutions, organisms, markets and collective intelligence. It is not biologically alive, conscious, or metaphysically real. The defensible description is a governed synthetic institutional lifeform, nonliving in the biological sense, life-like in organization, persistence, adaptation and coordinated behaviour. The safer technical term is developmental institutional intelligence system.
intended_outcome: No artifact, README, manifest, commit message or external communication claims consciousness or biological life for UNIIMENTE.
rationale: The founder's own correction: the mistake was never imagining something impossible, it was letting the discussion blur imitating life-like organization through software with claiming literal life. The first is an engineering programme; the second is unproven.
success_evidence: No artifact, README, manifest, commit message or external communication claims consciousness or biological life for UNIIMENTE.
failure_evidence: Any artifact, manifest, README or external communication asserting consciousness, sentience or biological life for UNIIMENTE.
next_review_trigger: any external publication describing UNIIMENTE
unresolved_questions: No automated check enforces this in prose artifacts; it is currently a human discipline.

title: Responsibility stays attributable as complexity rises
statement: The danger is not human irrelevance. The danger is human responsibility becoming detached from machine-mediated execution: a system continuing to function while nobody meaningfully understands, governs, or accepts responsibility for it. The architecture exists to prevent that failure mode. The system may become more capable, but responsibility must remain attributable, authority must remain bounded, and human intervention must remain structurally possible.
intended_outcome: Every consequential action resolves to a named human legal principal, and every external effect crosses a gate a human can close.
rationale: This is the founder's stated purpose for the whole architecture, and it is the criterion that makes the project stronger rather than weaker.
success_evidence: Every consequential action resolves to a named human legal principal, and every external effect crosses a gate a human can close.
unit_test: tests/unit/test_traceability.py TestUnauthorizedEffects
unit_test: tests/integration/test_phase_zero_connection.py::test_pumpstation_declares_no_treasury_or_signing_authority
failure_evidence: Any external effect whose receipt resolves to no grant, no witness, or no human legal principal.
Any running capability nobody named can stop.
next_review_trigger: any new organ registration or authority-matrix amendment

title: UNIIMENTE may grow in competence, never in sovereignty
statement: Growth is always bounded by constitutional authority, legal identity, capability grants, budgets, data permissions, consequence ceilings, external evidence, reversibility, shutdown and participant rights. No component may authorize its own promotion or expand its own sovereignty. Intelligence never creates authority.
source_refs: section 11, Growth Doctrine; CLAUDE.md permanent rules
intended_outcome: No module, agent, organ or gate can widen its own authority, and every manifest states may_self_promote false.
rationale: The single rule that separates a governed institution from an autonomous one.
success_evidence: No module, agent, organ or gate can widen its own authority, and every manifest states may_self_promote false.
unit_test: tests/integration/test_phase_zero_connection.py::test_pumpstation_declares_no_treasury_or_signing_authority
unit_test: governance/test/admission.test.js 'there is no override field'
failure_evidence: Any manifest declaring may_self_promote true.
Any component that widens its own authority or alters its own approval requirement.
next_review_trigger: any change to authority/authority-matrix.yaml

title: One metric governs: traceability from founder intent to outcome
statement: Percentage of completed goals that remain traceable from founder intent to decision, action, evidence, and outcome without unauthorized external effects. That metric combines intelligence, governance, continuity and safety.
intended_outcome: The metric is computable from the evidence ledger, refuses to report a number it has not earned, and names the institution's current bottleneck link.
rationale: One number no single subsystem can satisfy. Raising it requires intelligence, governance, continuity and honesty at once.
success_evidence: The metric is computable from the evidence ledger, refuses to report a number it has not earned, and names the institution's current bottleneck link.
unit_test: tests/unit/test_traceability.py (33 cases)
unit_test: TestRefusals::test_empty_ledger_refuses_a_rate_instead_of_reporting_100
failure_evidence: The metric reporting a rate it has not earned, such as 100% over an empty denominator.
A goal counted as traceable while an unauthorized external effect is attributed to it.
next_review_trigger: first production ledger that emits intent and decision records
unresolved_questions: Nothing yet emits intent or decision records, so the metric reports NOT REPORTABLE on every real ledger today.

title: The first serious prototype must prove five things
statement: It maintains a persistent identity across sessions and model changes; converts goals into coordinated specialist work; detects deviation from declared goals and policies; repairs or restructures itself within bounded permissions; and produces evidence explaining every meaningful decision and external action.
intended_outcome: Five named, separately demonstrable proofs, each with executable evidence rather than architecture.
rationale: This defines the smallest complete system that demonstrates the category, which the founder identifies as the actual bottleneck.
success_evidence: Five named, separately demonstrable proofs, each with executable evidence rather than architecture.
unit_test: tests/unit/test_traceability.py covers proof 5 (evidence for every decision) partially
unit_test: tests/unit/test_repair_harness.py covers proof 4 (bounded self-repair) partially
failure_evidence: A prototype milestone claimed while any of the five proofs has no executable evidence.
next_review_trigger: before claiming any prototype milestone
unresolved_questions: Which of the five are demonstrated end to end today, and by which executable evidence? No mapping exists yet.
Proof 1 (identity across model changes) has no test that actually swaps a model.

title: Build the smallest bounded digital creature, then repeat
statement: Stop debating whether the final organism is possible in the abstract. Build the smallest bounded digital creature that can receive one real goal, organize specialists, execute inside a sandbox, remember what happened, evaluate its own performance, propose a structural improvement, require approval before affecting the outside world, and preserve a complete causal record. Then repeat. Each successful cycle adds one verified mechanism.
intended_outcome: Delivery proceeds in verified cycles, each adding one mechanism with evidence, rather than in one architectural leap.
rationale: Accumulation of verified mechanisms is the founder's stated path to the complex nonliving system.
success_evidence: Delivery proceeds in verified cycles, each adding one mechanism with evidence, rather than in one architectural leap.
failure_evidence: A build package that adds architecture without completing one verified cycle end to end.
next_review_trigger: at the close of each build package
unresolved_questions: What is the one real goal for the first cycle? Not yet chosen.

title: Household egregore as a long-range product category
statement: A persistent domestic intelligence that learns household routines, coordinates devices, protects records and privacy, manages maintenance, teaches children, preserves family knowledge, monitors risks and develops a recognizable behavioural identity.
intended_outcome: Preserved as a candidate market direction. Nothing is built against it.
rationale: The founder identifies persistent synthetic institutions, not chatbots, as the commercial category. Recorded so the direction is not lost, and classified so it cannot become a build requirement by repetition.
success_evidence: Preserved as a candidate market direction. Nothing is built against it.
failure_evidence: Any implementation work started against this record while it remains an aspiration with no buyer evidence.
next_review_trigger: after the first verified three-repository causal episode
unresolved_questions: No buyer, no willingness-to-pay evidence, and no regulatory analysis of a system with household record access.

title: Corporate egregore as a long-range product category
statement: A system that preserves institutional knowledge beyond employee turnover, coordinates departments, maintains infrastructure, operates workflows continuously, monitors contracts and obligations, detects deterioration, simulates decisions, proposes repairs, enforces internal policy and negotiates through tightly limited authority.
intended_outcome: Preserved as a candidate market direction. Nothing is built against it.
rationale: Closest of the founder's product categories to what the three organs already do, so it is the most likely first commercial expression. Still aspiration until a buyer exists.
success_evidence: Preserved as a candidate market direction. Nothing is built against it.
failure_evidence: Any implementation work started against this record while it remains an aspiration with no buyer evidence.
next_review_trigger: first external buyer conversation
unresolved_questions: Which specific institutional failure does a first customer pay to remove?

title: Superseded: that humanity inevitably ends with no live players
statement: Original framing: 'The inevitable end is no live players remained in humanity.' Superseded within the same founder message: that outcome is not established, several futures are possible, and the more probable near-term outcome is that fewer humans directly understand the full systems they depend on, not that humans cease to be live players.
intended_outcome: The rejected framing stays visible, so the reasoning that replaced it is not silently re-litigated.
rationale: Superseded by intent:attributable-responsibility, which names the real failure mode: responsibility detaching from execution. Preserved rather than deleted because a discarded premise is evidence about how the design was reached.
success_evidence: The rejected framing stays visible, so the reasoning that replaced it is not silently re-litigated.
failure_evidence: Any design justified by the premise that human agency is destined to end, rather than by the attributability failure that replaced it.
next_review_trigger: never revived without external evidence

title: PumpStation is a security institution disguised as a memecoin platform
statement: PumpStation is UNIIMENTE's security-first Web3 wealth institution. Every memecoin, NFT, DAO, DeFi, wallet, smart-contract and agent feature serves an explicit protection, coordination, ownership, proof or settlement function. Every visible feature either creates value or reduces a specific attack surface. Nothing is added because it sounds Web3.
intended_outcome: No feature enters the PumpStation architecture without a declared security function.
rationale: Security as the central economic product rather than a pre-launch audit is the position competitors cannot copy quickly.
success_evidence: No feature enters the PumpStation architecture without a declared security function.
unit_test: governance/test/admission.test.js (33 cases)
failure_evidence: Any PumpStation feature admitted without a declared security function.
Any feature added because it sounds Web3.
next_review_trigger: each new PumpStation feature proposal

title: Every Web3 primitive is assigned a security job
statement: Wallets prove control and eliminate anonymous institutional commands. Decentralized identity binds actors to persistent identities. Zero-knowledge proofs prove facts while preserving privacy. NFTs represent passports, credentials and provenance. Smart contracts enforce allocations, vesting, liquidity locks and treasury limits. Multisig or MPC prevents single-key control. DAOs separate powers. Oracles use multiple sources so one cannot define reality. Timelocks give notice. Agent capability tokens give narrow, temporary, revocable authority instead of unrestricted wallet access. Blockchain technology is not automatically secure; these are used as mechanisms inside defence in depth.
source_refs: session 2026-07-27, 'Every Web3 primitive gets a security job'
intended_outcome: Each primitive, when introduced, is introduced with its named security function and its own introduced-threat analysis.
rationale: The founder's refinement is the load-bearing part: these technologies introduce catastrophic vulnerabilities of their own, so each must earn its place as a control.
success_evidence: Each primitive, when introduced, is introduced with its named security function and its own introduced-threat analysis.
unit_test: governance/test/admission.test.js 'R8: expanding authority while claiming zero new threats is refused'
failure_evidence: Any Web3 primitive introduced without its named security function and its own introduced-threat analysis.
next_review_trigger: introduction of any new Web3 primitive

title: PumpStation needs eight security layers
statement: Contract security; treasury security; agent security; governance security; market security; information security; human security; recovery security.
intended_outcome: Eight named layers, each with implementation and evidence, before any real-value deployment.
rationale: Defence in depth is what makes 'secure' mean bounded blast radius rather than absence of failure.
success_evidence: Eight named layers, each with implementation and evidence, before any real-value deployment.
unit_test: server/test/siwe.test.js (human security, partial)
unit_test: server/test/rate-limit.test.js (recovery security, partial)
failure_evidence: Any real-value deployment while a layer remains architecture with no implementation and no evidence.
next_review_trigger: before any real-value token or external DeFi connection is enabled
unresolved_questions: Six of eight layers are architecture with no code: contract, treasury, agent, governance, market and information security.
The layers have no ordering, so it is undecided which is built first.

title: Zero unrestricted agent or human treasury permissions
statement: No person or agent receives unrestricted treasury access. Every transfer requires authorized identity, permitted purpose, approved recipient, amount ceiling, expiration, required signers, transaction simulation and final state verification. Compromise of one agent or key exposes only a small, predetermined amount. Research agents cannot trade. Promotion agents cannot modify contracts. Treasury agents cannot approve their own proposals.
source_refs: session 2026-07-27, 'Treasury security' and the stage-gate external number
intended_outcome: A permission with a null spending ceiling, a wildcard action list, no expiry, or self-approval is refused by an executable gate.
rationale: This is the founder's stated external number for the stage-gate: zero unrestricted agent or human treasury permissions.
success_evidence: A permission with a null spending ceiling, a wildcard action list, no expiry, or self-approval is refused by an executable gate.

Any single key or person able to move treasury funds alone.

title: Termination trigger for features that buy authority without security
statement: Reject any feature that expands authority or financial exposure without a measurable security benefit, bounded failure radius and tested recovery path.
intended_outcome: The trigger runs as code in CI with no override flag, and a DEPLOYED feature that fails it exits non-zero.
rationale: A termination trigger that depends on someone remembering to apply it is a suggestion.
success_evidence: The trigger runs as code in CI with no override flag, and a DEPLOYED feature that fails it exits non-zero.

title: 'Secure' has a precise, limited meaning and excludes market risk
statement: PumpStation cannot promise that every token increases in value or that nobody loses money. Security means no hidden authority, no secret allocations, no unrestricted keys, no unrecorded institutional instructions, no unilateral treasury movement, no silent rule changes, no undisclosed promotion, no agent self-authorization, no unnecessary personal-data exposure, bounded financial blast radius, visible risk, attributable decisions, rapid detection and tested recovery. Market risk remains.
source_refs: session 2026-07-27, "'Secure' must have a precise meaning"
intended_outcome: No PumpStation communication implies protection from market loss.
rationale: Overclaiming what security covers is the fastest way to convert a security institution into a liability.
success_evidence: No PumpStation communication implies protection from market loss.
failure_evidence: Any communication implying protection from market loss, guaranteed returns, or that participants cannot lose money.
next_review_trigger: any public PumpStation communication
unresolved_questions: No automated check prevents a future README or landing page from implying protection from market loss.

title: Eight conditions before anything may be called the Golden Kernel
statement: The repository may be named uniimente-golden-kernel, but its status remains GOLDEN_KERNEL_CANDIDATE and NOT_PRODUCTION_CERTIFIED until eight conditions hold: one authority path; clean reproducibility from a fresh clone; demonstrated stateful continuity including black-start recovery; truthful runtime state derived from canonical evidence rather than manual claims; security closure; completed convergence classification of every overlapping implementation; full verification on the exact release commit; and founder ratification of the release and its constitutional hash.
source_refs: session 2026-07-27, 'When it earns the name Golden Kernel'
intended_outcome: No artifact carries the Golden Kernel name until all eight conditions have objective evidence and the founder has ratified.
rationale: Calling it finished before reconciliation would turn an aspiration into a false status claim. The founder said so explicitly.
success_evidence: No artifact carries the Golden Kernel name until all eight conditions have objective evidence and the founder has ratified.
failure_evidence: Any artifact carrying the Golden Kernel name before all eight conditions have objective evidence and the founder has ratified.

title: The ZIP lineage and the constitutional lineage connect deliberately, never silently
statement: Do not merge directly into uniimente-kernel/main. That repository currently represents the newer constitutional lineage. The two lineages need to be connected deliberately rather than one silently overwriting the other.
intended_outcome: Any convergence between the two lineages arrives as a reviewable pull request with lineage recorded, never as a direct push to a default branch.
rationale: Two lineages silently merged lose the record of which decisions came from which, which is the institutional memory the build order exists to protect.
success_evidence: Any convergence between the two lineages arrives as a reviewable pull request with lineage recorded, never as a direct push to a default branch.
failure_evidence: Any direct push to uniimente-kernel main from the ZIP lineage.
Any merge between the lineages that does not record which decisions came from which.
next_review_trigger: first convergence pull request between the lineages

title: Preserve every useful implementation, test, document, branch and proof record
statement: Do not delete valuable code, tests, documents, branches, proof records, schemas, experiments, failed approaches or historical implementations. Do not destroy institutional memory to create architectural neatness. A superseded implementation may be marked inactive, wrapped, registered as experimental, isolated, retained as fallback, designated read-only, assigned to historical replay or converted into a benchmark opponent. It must not simply disappear.
intended_outcome: Superseded work stays reachable with its lineage, and duplication that exists for preservation is documented so an audit does not remove it.
rationale: Code may stop being active. It must not stop being institutional memory.
success_evidence: Superseded work stays reachable with its lineage, and duplication that exists for preservation is documented so an audit does not remove it.
